entities.summary: Yuliya Berberyan-Maleeva is a Bulgarian former tennis player. She and her husband, Georgi Maleev, had three daughters, Manuela, Katerina, and Magdalena, who were coached by their mother and won 40 WTA singles tournaments combined.
